title: Dry Soil Checker to Save Pump Electricity
title_te: మోటార్ కరెంట్ ఆదా చేసే పొడి మట్టి చెకర్
problem: Abba leaves the motor pump running all night even when the soil is already wet. It wastes electricity and washes away good soil nutrients.
idea: A soil checker. The camera looks at the soil and tells if it needs water or not. A calculator also shows how much power is wasted by extra pump hours.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: What soil does the camera see?
widgets.intro: In my real project, Teachable Machine learned wet soil and cracked dry soil from photos.
widgets.question: The soil near the plant roots looks like:

options.label: Dark, wet, sticks together
options.result: Soil is wet. NO pumping needed today. Switch off the motor!
options.te: మట్టి తడిగా ఉంది. ఈరోజు నీళ్ళు అవసరం లేదు. మోటార్ ఆపండి!

options.label: Slightly damp, crumbles
options.result: Soil is OK. Water lightly tomorrow morning.
options.te: మట్టి సరిపోతుంది. రేపు ఉదయం కొంచెం నీళ్ళు పెట్టండి.

options.label: Light colour, big cracks
options.result: Soil is dry. Plants need water now. Water in the early morning or evening.
options.te: మట్టి పొడిగా ఉంది. ఇప్పుడు నీళ్ళు పెట్టండి.

widgets.heading: ⚡ How much power does extra pumping waste?
widgets.intro: 1 HP motor uses about 0.75 units (kWh) per hour. Change the numbers for your motor.

inputs.label: Extra hours run on wet soil (per night)
Number of nights in a month

widgets.formula: if (hp <= 0 || extraHours < 0 || nights < 0) return null; var u = hp * 0.746 * extraHours * nights; var lvl = u > 100 ? 'bad' : (u > 30 ? 'warn' : 'good'); return {units: Math.round(u), level: lvl};
widgets.result:
About {units} units of electricity wasted in a month.
That power and groundwater could be saved for dry days!

questions.q: Soil is dark and sticks in your hand. Pump?
questions.why: Wet soil does not need more water. Extra water washes nutrients away.
Less water is lost to the sun in the morning or evening.

questions.q: What else is lost when we over-water?
questions.why: Extra water washes good nutrients deep below the roots.

how: Open teachablemachine.withgoogle.com and choose Image Project.
Make classes: Wet soil, Damp soil, Dry cracked soil. Add about 50 clear photos to each class (from our field or from the Agriculture Officer's pictures).
Click Train Model. Test it with new photos it has never seen.
Click Export, upload the model and copy the shareable link.
In PictoBlox, load the model and add 'If Wet soil → say Switch off the motor' in Telugu.
Add an extra calculator: ask motor HP and hours, say units = HP × 0.746 × hours.
Ask Gemini for simple water-saving tips and test the project in our field with Abba.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student. Explain to a farmer in simple English and Telugu how to check by hand if soil needs water (squeeze test), why over-watering at night wastes electricity and soil nutrients, and give 5 easy water-saving tips.
